name: Knife Strife 🔪
desc:
Welcome to Knife Strife! Fight off enemies and unlock brand new knives with different abilities!

❗If you have suggestions or would like to report a bug let us know in our communications server❗

👍⭐ Please Like and Favorite, it helps us out and boosts us on the algorithm!

Controls -
Click / RT / Tap Screen - Attack
E / B / Tap Ability Button - Ability
Left Shift / DPAD Down / Tap Lock Button - Shift Lock

Inspired by Slap Battles
